display_name: The Forty-five Martyrs of Nicopolis in Armenia

names.form: Cei 45 de Mucenici din Nicopolea Armeniei
names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 10 iulie, «Sfinții 45 de Mucenici din Nicopolea Armeniei», with the rank word left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 10 iulie — «Sfinții 45 de Mucenici din Nicopolea Armeniei»

attestations.note: This is one folder and not forty-five, because the page does not enumerate the company: its narrative names six men — Leontius, Mauricius, Daniel, Antoninus, Alexander and Sisinius — out of the forty-five, and no list of the rest is printed anywhere on it.
Not checked: saint.gr for 10 Ιουλίου (24 September 2026).
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoințele lor, cununile nestricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au și ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuiește sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfinților 45 de Mucenici din Nicopolea Armeniei», Glasul 4 — the common troparion of martyrs, printed here for this company

english.text: Your martyrs, Lord, in their struggles received from You, our God, the crowns of incorruption; for having Your strength they overthrew their torturers and broke the powerless insolence of the demons. At their prayers, Christ God, save our souls.
